title: Preliminary structural design and analysis of a high altitude hybrid airship.
author: Juliano de Oliveira Faria
abstract: Lift can be produced in two distinguished way shich combined by Hybrid Airships. One way is by the difference of density between the atmosphere and the airship. That construction is well utilized in balloons and zeppelins. The other way is to produce lift dynamically by a difference of pressure between accelerated fluids over a surface. As examples we have airplanes (wings) and helicopters (rotor blades). The absence of analytical or semi analytical methods gives the preliminary design an ammount of uncertainty. One method which has proven to be efficient in thin-walled aero-structures is the shear-panel rod model. In that model we assume that each element is composed with a shear panel which is assumed to carry only shear forces (no bending stiffness) and a rod which carries longitudinal stresses. In this work the shear-panel rod model for the determination of the weight and the stiffness distribution in the airship. The calculations will also be done making use of the finite element NASTRAN.
